queries.name: Extension graph
queries.description: Show edges in the A2A extension.
queries.query: MATCH p=(a)-[r]->(b) WHERE type(r) STARTS WITH "A2A_" RETURN p

queries.name: Unauthenticated access to skills and operations
queries.description: Every path from unauthenticated callers to a skill or API operation.
queries.query:
MATCH (s:A2A_PublicAccess), (t) WHERE t:A2A_APIOperation OR t:A2A_Skill
MATCH p=allShortestPaths((s)-[:A2A_Anonymous|A2A_HasSkill|A2A_BackedBy|A2A_ServesAgent|A2A_CanDelegateTo|A2A_RunsAs|A2A_HasScope|A2A_GrantsAccessTo|A2A_HoldsCredential|A2A_AuthenticatesTo*1..8]->(t))
RETURN p

queries.name: Token issuers to write and delete operations
queries.description: Token issuers to write and delete operations.
queries.query:
MATCH (s:A2A_AuthorizationServer), (t:A2A_APIOperation) WHERE t.method IN ["POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE"]
MATCH p=allShortestPaths((s)-[:A2A_IssuesTokensFor|A2A_DefinesScope|A2A_GrantsAccessTo|A2A_AuthenticatesTo|A2A_HasSkill|A2A_BackedBy*1..6]->(t))
RETURN p

queries.name: Unsigned agent cards
queries.query: MATCH (a:A2A_Agent) WHERE a.signed = false RETURN a

queries.name: Agent skills, interfaces, extensions and authentication
queries.description: Each agent with its skills, interfaces, extensions and auth.

queries.name: Agents, skills and API operations
queries.description: Agents, skills and the API operations behind them.

queries.name: Agent access to skills and operations
queries.description: Every agent to every skill and operation it can reach.
queries.query:
MATCH (s:A2A_Agent), (t) WHERE (t:A2A_Skill OR t:A2A_APIOperation) AND s <> t
MATCH p=allShortestPaths((s)-[:A2A_HasSkill|A2A_BackedBy|A2A_RunsAs|A2A_HasScope|A2A_GrantsAccessTo|A2A_HoldsCredential|A2A_AuthenticatesTo|A2A_CanDelegateTo*1..8]->(t))
RETURN p

queries.name: Host exposure to agents and skills
queries.description: Hosts (servers) to the agents and skills they expose, or what a host compromise reaches.
